paragraphs.en: When the man and his goods reached Nanjing, someone had already reported to Shaoshan: "Your father has brought goods to sell, and he means to find you as well." Dismayed at the news, Shaoshan quickly called in the brothel madam, Mao Xiqing, to scheme with her: "My father has come expressly to press me to return home. If you have a plan to trap him into whoring too, then I can stay here for good; otherwise, I must part from you today." Xiqing said, "Just hide yourself deep inside and do not let him see you; I will take care of everything." She immediately sent someone to invite Madam Xun Rong from the front courtyard and asked her to lay a clever snare for him. Madam Rong agreed and left.

paragraphs.zh: 東溪問在京客夥，知子在毛惜卿家嫖其女月華，徑尋惜卿家來，欲呼子歸。惜卿出而款待甚恭。東溪曰：「小頑少山在你家，我到京十餘日矣，可叫他出來見我。」惜卿悚敬曰：「相公即少山令尊乎？妾幸披雲睹日也。令郎前在寒舍兩三個月，今月餘前送別久矣。」即喚女月華出見，指曰：「此爾翁也。」命下拜。東溪不禮之。又命設席。東溪曰：「吾為不肖子而來，豈索汝酒食乎？速叫兒與我歸，亦不消你假意相留。」月華曰：「果是前月已去，云欲收帳回家。若果在此，何敢相瞞？」東溪不信，定要究子下落。惜卿曰：「茅舍隻數間，任相公遍搜之。豈能藏得？」月華領東溪入內，四下覓之，無踪。東溪大怒曰：「牙人說在此，如何藏開，說這鬼話？若吾兒不見，是你家謀死，必當官告你，著你尋覓！」月華驚曰：「從來院中那有謀人者？相公勿輕易怪人。」東溪詬罵而出。
paragraphs.en: Inquiring among fellow merchants in Nanjing, Dongxi learned that his son was whoring at Mao Xiqing's house with her girl Yuehua, so he went straight to Xiqing's establishment to call his son back. Xiqing came out and received him with the utmost deference. Dongxi said, "My wayward boy Shaoshan is in your house. I have been in Nanjing for over ten days now—call him out to see me at once." With respectful alarm, Xiqing replied, "So Your Honor is Young Master Shaoshan's venerable father! How fortunate I am to part the clouds and behold the sun! Your worthy son did visit my humble house some time ago, and knowing that a young man away from home ought not squander his wealth, I earnestly urged him to head back. Half a month ago he set out with several guests for Suzhou and Hangzhou to buy goods, saying he would return home directly from there. Please sit a while and take a cup of tea, Your Honor; I would not dare detain you further." Still suspicious, Dongxi glared with rage and shouted, "Every fellow merchant in town says he is right here in your house! How dare you try to fool me with wine and food? Call my son out at once to return home with me, and spare me your false show of respect!" Fixing him with a solemn look, Xiqing said, "Even in a humble house like ours, we value honesty and good faith. Why don't you search inside, Your Honor? Why let outsiders' gossip make you wrong an innocent household?" She led Dongxi through every room inside and out; finding no trace of his son, he cursed his way out the door.

paragraphs.zh: 行過院前，窗內一女將盆水傾出，淋東溪一身，冠服盡濕。時怒未散，問「此是誰人家？」僕來祿曰：「此一行都是樂戶人家。」東溪即入其門指罵。荀榮媽出，驚惶問故，知是女荀慶雲誤傾水淋著，即喚出，棒打無數。慶雲哀求勸救，東溪亦不睬。榮媽曰：「你好將新服換與相公，向前叩頭求赦，留在此陪人禮，免後日生禍。」
paragraphs.en: As he passed the front of the next house, a girl inside flung out a basin of water that drenched Dongxi from head to foot, soaking his hat and robes. His anger had not yet cooled. "Whose house is this?" he asked. His servant Lailu said, "This whole row is licensed pleasure houses." Dongxi marched straight in the gate, pointing and cursing. Mama Xun Rong came out in alarm and asked what had happened; learning that her girl Xun Qingyun had carelessly thrown the water on him, she called the girl out at once and beat her unmercifully. Qingyun begged for mercy and pleaded for someone to rescue her, but Dongxi paid no heed. Mama Rong said, "You had better bring a fresh set of clothes for the master to change into, then go to him, kowtow, and beg his pardon—and keep him here to make proper amends, so this does not bring trouble on us later."

paragraphs.zh: 慶雲叩頭訖，引入內房，取一套新衣與更，跪曰：「我等人家，最怕得罪於人。萬望海度涵容，恕妾罪過。」東溪曰：「我原不怪你，只衣濕難行。我今換去，明日即送還矣。」拂衣便起。慶雲挽曰：「更有杯酒陪禮。若便去，媽又怪責我矣。」東溪曰：「何消酒？」時筵已排列，慶雲曲意陪奉，東溪亦放懷樂飲。至晚欲去，慶雲懇留曰：「今半載空房，若不宿而去，真對面不相逢也。你宿則媽歡喜，謂我善留客。此豈費房錢乎？」又飲到二更而睡。東溪思房錢終是還之，且假意不動，以試何如。慶雲偎抱撫摩之曰：「君作柳下惠，坐懷不亂耶？是入寶山空手回也。且暮夜無知，誰知爾貞節男者？」東溪笑而從之。
paragraphs.en: When Qingyun had finished kowtowing, she led him into an inner room, brought a new set of clothes for him to change into, and knelt, saying, "People in houses like ours live in dread of giving offense. I beg you to be generous and forgive my fault." Dongxi said, "I never blamed you to begin with—wet clothes are just hard to walk in. I will change now and send these back tomorrow." He shook out his sleeves and made to rise. Qingyun held him back: "There is still a cup of wine to make amends. If you leave right away, Mama will scold me again." Dongxi said, "What need is there for wine?" But by then the feast was already laid out. Qingyun waited on him with every art of pleasing, and Dongxi let himself go and drank merrily. Toward evening he wanted to leave. Qingyun begged him earnestly to stay: "This room has stood empty for half a year. If you go without staying the night, it is as though we met face to face and never met at all. If you stay, Mama will be pleased and say I know how to keep a guest. And it will not even cost you room money." They drank on until the second watch, then went to bed. Dongxi reckoned he would pay for the room in the end anyway, so for the moment he feigned indifference and lay still, to see what would happen. Qingyun nestled into his arms and stroked him, saying, "Are you playing Liuxia Hui, sitting with a woman in your lap and staying unmoved? That is walking into a mountain of treasure and coming back empty-handed. Besides, in the dark of night no one is watching—who would ever know what a chaste man you were?" Dongxi smiled and gave in.

paragraphs.zh: 次日近午方起。才梳洗罷，酒席已備，慢慢勸飲，彈唱以奉之。靠晚，又欲歸。慶雲留曰：「肯宿媽媽甚喜。若一宵而別，真是萍水之逢，落花有意，流水無心也。妾縱奉侍不周，君何不做甘雨，濟我半載旱人？」東溪又為留一夜。第三日，堅要歸，求還舊服。慶雲曰：「已遣人送往貴寓矣。」東溪曰：「承賜身上服，明日送還。」慶雲曰：「只恐不中服，何不收作表記？」又取出一箱玩物，欲擇一件相贈。東溪見箱中皆珠玉寶玩，僅取一牙扇墜。慶雲曰：「此不敢奉，此銀的敬奉。」東溪曰：「只領你意耳，何必送銀物？」慶雲曰：「此牙的是禮部公子所贈，旁刻有號。凡孤老所賜，唯銀得用。若簪甸諸玩物，須存留之。後日有會，問及即在，方表不忘之意，故不敢轉贈於人。此銀扇墜，乃預打造，以回答人者，旁鑄有妾名，故願相贈也。」東溪受之而歸。
paragraphs.en: The next day he did not rise until nearly noon. Barely finished washing and combing when the wine feast was ready; they plied him slowly with drink and sang and played for him. Toward evening he again wanted to go back. Qingyun kept him: "If you are willing to stay, Mama will be so pleased. To part after a single night would be a mere chance meeting on the road—the fallen flowers have feelings, but the flowing stream has no heart. Even if my service has been wanting, why will you not be a generous rain and relieve a woman who has suffered a half-year drought?" So Dongxi stayed another night. On the third day he insisted on going back and asked for his old clothes. Qingyun said, "I have already sent someone to deliver them to your lodgings." Dongxi said, "These clothes you gave me, I will return tomorrow." Qingyun said, "I only fear they do not suit you. Why not keep them as a keepsake?" She also brought out a box of trinkets, meaning to choose one as a gift for him. Dongxi saw that the box was full of pearls, jades, and precious curios, and took only an ivory fan pendant. Qingyun said, "That one I dare not give you—but this silver one I offer with respect." Dongxi said, "I am grateful for the thought alone; why give me something of silver?" Qingyun said, "The ivory one was a gift from the son of a Ministry of Rites official, with his mark carved on the side. Of all the gifts our benefactors give us, only silver may be spent. Hairpins, jade ornaments, and such trinkets must be kept. If the giver visits later and asks after it, it has to be here to show we have not forgotten him—so I dare not pass it on to anyone else. This silver fan pendant was made in advance for giving in return, with my name cast on the side, so I would like you to have it." Dongxi accepted it and went back.

paragraphs.zh: 明日，謂來祿曰：「看妓家極難做，只誤傾一盆水，費盡小心承奉人，唯恐不當人意，我豈可過吃她物？我宿兩晚，又吃四席酒，以銀四兩與之；受一銀扇墜，以金銀玉三枝簪答之，並這身衣服，你送去還他，我不再去。」原來前兩夜來祿亦得婢桂英伴宿，兩人情意綢繆，更相捨不得。臨行囑咐曰：「主人若再來嫖，又得再會。」故來祿只願得主肯嫖，力勸曰：「前日空手去，也這般相敬；今日有銀有簪送她，她不留宿，豈不留酒乎？再吃她何妨？」東溪信之，再與僕往，以銀與簪送之。
paragraphs.en: The next day he said to Lailu, 'It strikes me how hard a courtesan's house has to work. Over one carelessly spilled basin of water, they exerted such great care in attending to me, afraid only of displeasing me. How could I go on consuming her substance? I stayed two nights and ate four feasts of wine—give her four taels of silver. I accepted a silver fan pendant—answer it with three hairpins, of gold, silver, and jade. Take these clothes I am wearing back too. You deliver them; I am not going again.' As it happened, on the two previous nights Lailu had been given the maid Guiying to share his bed, and the two had grown tenderly attached and could hardly bear to part. As he left she had charged him, "If your master comes whoring again, we can meet again." So Lailu's one wish was for his master to keep whoring, and he urged him hard: "The other day you went empty-handed, and they still treated you with such respect. Today you have silver and hairpins to give her—even if she does not keep you the night, will she not keep you for wine? What harm in one more meal at her place?" Dongxi believed him and went again with the servant to present the silver and the hairpins.

paragraphs.zh: 慶雲得了，喜色滿面，持入誇與媽曰：「左相公送我銀四兩、簪三根。非妾趨奉得歡喜，豈送許多禮乎？」荀媽亦大喜，出叩謝曰：「本不當受厚禮，既蒙賜，還在寒舍消耍幾日。」東溪假辭要回，慶雲挽入內房，酒席已備。東溪曰：「又煩宴我，後何以報？」慶雲曰：「前日止是陪禮，今日所賜銀，已准後帳。」東溪曰：「前銀還前，我若嫖，須從今日算起。」由是日夜流連，忘其時月。來祿亦得再與桂英會，二人喜不自勝，侍奉加殷勤，使喚加聽命。主僕皆樂而忘歸矣。
paragraphs.en: Qingyun took the gifts, her face alight with joy, and carried them in to boast to Mama: "Mr. Zuo sent me four taels of silver and three hairpins. If I had not pleased him with my attentions, would he send so many gifts?" Mama Xun was delighted and came out to kowtow her thanks: "We really should not accept such generous gifts, but since you honor us with them, do stay and amuse yourself at our humble house a few more days." Dongxi made a show of insisting on going back; Qingyun drew him into the inner room, where the feast was already laid. Dongxi said, "Troubling you to feast me again—how shall I repay it later?" Qingyun said, "Last time was only an apology. The silver you gave today already counts toward the bill to come." Dongxi said, "That silver settles what went before. If I am to whore, the reckoning starts from today." From then on he lingered day and night and lost track of the months. Lailu, too, was reunited with Guiying; the two were beside themselves with joy, waited on their betters with redoubled zeal, and jumped to obey every order. Master and servant alike were having too good a time to think of going home.

paragraphs.zh: 東溪時或謂僕曰：「當要知止，銀費去多矣。」來祿便誘曰：「人有金帛，正要追歡買笑。相公掌如許大家，才得此幾月快心，縱此銀用盡，家中何患無吃著？不及趁此未老時行樂，人生寧有百年，何必作守銀虜也？」東溪心本迷戀，又累被來祿勸誘，並不知回頭。不覺半年餘，三百金幾盡。桂英時向來祿索衣服簪珥，來祿轉於主，主曰：「亦未知我用多少，須與荀媽算之，然後留盤纏回去。」及算過，已用過三百餘兩，盡貨物還之，尚未夠，盤纏全無辦。來祿曰：「小主本多，可去借些。」東溪曰：「不好開口。你去婉轉言之。」少山知父本嫖盡，撫掌大笑，令月華設席請父。及慶雲來餞行，然後東溪與子默默同歸。只謂緣遇使然，不知為計所陷。
paragraphs.en: From time to time Dongxi would say to his servant, "A man should know when to stop. I have spent a great deal of silver." Lailu would urge him on: "When a man has gold and silk, that is exactly when he should chase pleasure and buy smiles. You run such a great household, master, and only now have you had a few months of real enjoyment. Even if this silver runs out, what worry is there of food or clothing at home? Why not take your pleasure while you are not yet old? Does a life last a hundred years? Why be a slave to guarding silver?" Dongxi's heart was already besotted, and with Lailu urging him on again and again, he never thought of turning back. Before he knew it, more than half a year had passed and the three hundred taels were nearly gone. Guiying kept asking Lailu for clothes and hairpins, and Lailu passed the requests on to his master. The master said, "I do not even know how much I have spent. I must settle accounts with Mama Xun, and then keep back travel money for the trip home." When the reckoning was done, he had spent more than three hundred taels; even handing over all his goods did not cover it, and there was no travel money to be had at all. Lailu said, "The young master has plenty of capital. You could borrow some from him." Dongxi said, "I cannot bring myself to ask. You go and speak to him delicately." Shaoshan, learning that his father's capital had been squandered on pleasure to the last, clapped his hands and roared with laughter, and had Yuehua lay a feast for his father. Qingyun came too, to see him off. Then Dongxi and his son made the journey home together in silence. He put it all down to fate, and never knew he had been caught in a scheme.

paragraphs.zh: 按：尤物移人，麗色傾城，自昔慨之。安有入蠖中而皓然不滓者？東溪非為而來，直欲尋子而歸。其深知妓之迷人與嫖之破家深矣，乃入其中而掘泥揚波，更甚於子。不邇聲色、不溺情慾者既幾人哉！孔（子）曰：「吾未見好德如好色者也。」則賢之易色者信難矣。故院中語曰：「不怕深來不乖，只怕深乖不來。」則唯勿蹈其地者，可超然樊籠外矣。不然，未有不受其羈迷者。
paragraphs.en: Note: That a rare beauty can bewitch a man and a lovely face topple a city has been lamented since ancient times. Who ever stepped into the mire and came out white and unstained? Dongxi did not go there for pleasure; he only meant to find his son and bring him home. He knew full well how courtesans bewitch men and how whoring ruins a family—yet once inside, he churned the mud and rode the waves even deeper than his son. How few are the men who keep their distance from song and beauty and do not drown in desire! Confucius said, "I have never seen a man who loves virtue the way he loves beauty." One who is worthy enough to turn his love from beauty is truly rare. Hence the saying in the quarter: "They never fear that a steady customer will not be tamed; they only fear that the truly wary man will not come." Only the man who never sets foot on that ground can stand free beyond the cage. Otherwise none escapes its bonds and its spell.
